claims.text: SummIt is an iterative text summarization framework using large language models that refines generated summaries through self-evaluation and feedback.
Human evaluation validates the effectiveness of SummIt's iterative summary refinements.
The iterative refinement process in SummIt introduces a potential issue of over-correction.

evidence.description: The authors introduce SummIt, which enables LLMs like ChatGPT to refine summaries iteratively via self-evaluation and feedback.
A human evaluation was conducted to validate the effectiveness of the model's summary refinements.
Human evaluation revealed a potential issue of over-correction during the refinement process.

methodologies.name: SummIt
methodologies.description: An iterative text summarization framework based on large language models that incorporates self-evaluation, feedback, and optional knowledge and topic extractors.
conditions: integration of knowledge and topic extractors

limitations.text: One-shot text summarization systems generate summaries in a single step, which can produce hallucinations or miss key details relevant to reader interests.
The iterative refinement approach in SummIt exhibits a potential issue of over-correction.
